name: yETH weighted-stableswap solver invariant collapse
summary: Extreme imbalanced deposits drove the weighted-stableswap supply solver outside its valid domain until its product term collapsed to zero, yet the pool accepted the divergent result and over-minted yETH LP. The attacker repaired only the product through zero-value removal, used permissionless rate reconciliation to burn protocol-owned LP rather than their own, drained the LST pool, then re-entered the zero-supply bootstrap path and triggered an unchecked underflow to mint enough yETH to drain the yETH/WETH Curve pool.
notes: Top-level deployment of the direct weighted-stableswap runtime; its deployment-block and pre-exploit hashes match.

Yearn's disclosure lists the eight pre-exploit LST balances in the yETH pool and 298.35 WETH in the downstream Curve pool; live balance checks show each LST balance reduced below 0.000000000000001 token units and the Curve pool reduced to 0.221058531986020280 WETH in the exploit block. Reputable reporting values the gross extraction at approximately $9 million. The later coordinated recovery of 857.49 pxETH is not subtracted from gross loss.
The $9 million gross loss is a rounded reported USD valuation; Yearn's disclosure and the onchain review provide the affected token quantities and confirm the pool depletion.
